==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by Endfield Industries Engineering Division.

Despite its smart design<ref>[[AIC Gauntlets]]</ref>,This gear's material's choice leads to massive increases in weight<ref>[[AIC Heavy Plate]]</ref>, it is even said that this gear "would likely end up at places where it becomes the target of powerful guns."<ref>[[AIC Heavy Armor]]</ref>
